news.h: Franklin wins appeal, cleared for Ravens
news.b: The NFL reduced Sam Franklin Jr.'s one-game spitting suspension to a $14,926 fine after hearing officer James Thrash ruled on his appeal on Oct. 23. He is eligible to face Baltimore on Nov. 1.
C.J. Gardner-Johnson's one-game suspension was upheld on appeal, and he was also fined $11,194 for unnecessary roughness against the Raiders. He will sit out the Ravens game.
With Lamar Jackson out again and Tyler Huntley at QB, Baltimore was outscored 35-0 in the second half of a 35-13 home loss to Cincinnati on Sunday and falls to 4-3 before visiting Orchard Park.

news.h: Bills open as Week 8 favorites; Dolphins win first
news.b: Buffalo opened as about a 3- to 3.5-point home favorite over Baltimore. In the division, Miami got its first win, 28-25 over the Jets, leaving New York 2-5 and the Dolphins 1-5.

source: Spectrum News Buffalo (Oct 23), NFL.com Week 7 recap, NY Jets recap, FootballDB scores, SI/FanDuel and SportsBettingDime odds; checked Oct 26, 2026.
